bio.text: Segun Adeyina was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in November 2022 and represents District 110.

According to his legislative biography, Adeyina has worked for more than 25 years in IT program and project management for Fortune 500 companies, including General Motors, Ascension Health System and Hewlett Packard/Cap Gemini.
The biography says he is executive director of the Nigerian American Public Advisory Committee U.S.A. and was a 2020 Democratic candidate for the Gwinnett County School Board.
